blurb: This check verifies that the default AIX system accounts (bin, sys, adm, and lpd, with root excepted) are not granted cron access. If /var/adm/cron/cron.allow exists it must not be empty and must not list those accounts; if it does not exist, those accounts must instead be listed in /var/adm/cron/cron.deny. When a default system account can submit cron jobs, those jobs run with the privileges of that account and can be used to maintain unauthorized access or disrupt scheduled work.
